newsitem.title: USA: Tricord Systems Q1 results as expected.
newsitem.headline: Tricord Systems Q1 results as expected.

text.p: Tricord Systems Inc reported its 1997 first quarter loss and lower revenues were expected and reflect a shift in business.
"First quarter revenues reflect the change in the company's direction," said John Mitcham, president.
"These results are in line with the company's estimates during this transitionary period," he said in a statement on Wednesday.

In February, Tricord announced a strategic shift from the manufacture of server hardware to the development and marketing of file-intelligent network-attached storage products for the Windows NT market.

Earlier today, Tricord reported a 1997 first quarter loss of $5.1 million or $0.38 a share compared with a loss of $1.9 million or $0.14 in the same period a year ago. The 1997 first quarter includes a charge of $247,000 or $0.02 a share from the disposal of certain assets that, from the business shift, are no longer required.
Revenues for the first quarter fell to $4.9 million from $18.4 million.
